caches.const: fresh unrelated Gradle/Cargo/target/node/temp roots; offline inputs digest verified

prefixItems.const: secrets out of band and redacted

network.const: isolated LAN; outbound denied; declared endpoints only

processes.const: supervisor, nodes, monitors and OS baseline only; inventory hashed

planned_fault_exclusion.const: only predeclared scenario IDs and timestamps

reorg_rule.const: removed events precede deterministic reapply and converge exactly

comparison.const: byte-identical complete logical store roots at common committed heights

deadline_boundary.const: inclusive: a sample exactly at the deadline is evaluated

failure_counting.const: pre-deadline mismatches are retained but ignored; each evaluated post-deadline sample that differs beyond zero tolerance increments the counter

first_evaluation.const: first sample whose timestamp is at or after reference timestamp plus deadline_seconds

raw_samples.const: retain every timestamped Java and Rust observation without filtering

reference.const: scenario event timestamp and the Java reference committed height/root/event set captured at that timestamp

required_disposition.const: approved; no unknown ownership, missing terms, incompatible obligation, absent notice, or expired exception

dataset.const: authenticated deterministic 100000-block chain and frozen seeds

failed_or_censored_rule.const: any failed, timed-out, incomplete, or censored Java or Rust run fails the metric

implementation.const: pinned Java and Rust on identical clean P-LINUX-X64 hosts

pairing_rule.const: compute each paired Rust/Java latency-resource ratio or Java/Rust throughput ratio, then use the median of exactly three pair ratios

variability_rule.const: maximum/minimum of the three pair ratios must be <=1.10 and the two-sided 95% bootstrap confidence upper bound (10000 deterministic resamples, seed 3008001) must satisfy the ratio budget

measurement_boundary.const: first accepted transaction through final commit
process start to ready at height 100000
process start to ready at snapshot head
process spawn to all readiness probes green

const.execution_rule: run all ten metric workloads sequentially; for each workload run warmup Java then Rust followed by the three pinned measured pairs in order; no overlap or omitted run is allowed

purpose.const: diagnosis only; rejected by release gate

eligible_seconds_definition.const: soak seconds minus the union of approved planned exclusion windows

overlap_accounting.const: union per affected node; overlapping seconds counted once

qualification_decision.const: Only complete release-profile evidence satisfying all minima, exact coverage, zero/tolerance invariants, budgets, closure, digest reconciliation, unexpired independent approvals and threshold signatures passes; developer output never qualifies.

evidence_hash.const: SHA-256 each file plus ordered inventory SHA-256

expiry_rule.const: results and approvals/exceptions unexpired through publication

required_scenario_coverage.const: exact scenario manifest item set and order; each scenario result must bind its exact manifest observation subjects to non-boolean measured expected/actual values and inventoried evidence; missing, fabricated, skipped, not_run, unknown fail

low.const: closed or unexpired disposition approved by security-lead and owning-domain-owner

medium.const: closed or unexpired exception approved by security-lead and owning-domain-owner

port_policy.const: exact frozen mapping; no defaults, reuse, wildcard API exposure, or silent remapping

release_identity_source.const: authenticated signed C028 release manifest: release_id, version, release_sequence, channel, source_revision and artifact digests

bounds.const: finite count, concurrency, payload size, rate, timeout and deterministic seed required before execution; unbounded/open-loop work invalid

const.allocation_algorithm: For each zero-based run and action, rank phase indexes 0..23 by ascending raw SHA-256 bytes of UTF-8 '{seed}:{run_index}:{action}:{phase_index}', take the first per_run_action_counts[action] ranks, then sort selected phases ascending; the sorted position is occurrence_index. Within each phase order actions by action_order.
const.canonicalization: Generate one object per action with keys action, action_end_second, action_start_second, exclusion_end_second, exclusion_start_second, fork_activation, occurrence_index, phase_index, run_index; timestamps are integer seconds relative to suite start. Serialize the full run/phase/action ordered array as UTF-8 JSON with lexicographically sorted keys and separators ',' and ':' and hash with SHA-256.
const.exclusion_window_rule: Each action has action_start_second = run_index*21600 + phase_index*900 + 60 + phase_action_slot*90, action_end_second = start+60, and a predeclared planned exclusion window [start,start+120). No other lifecycle exclusion is allowed; overlapping windows use the release-profile union rule.
const.fork_activation_rule: Exactly occurrence_index 0 of reorg in each run is a fork activation; the remaining reorg actions are non-activation reorgs.
